quests.title: Awakening: Know Thy Place
quests.description: You awaken in a strange dungeon. The air hums with arcane energy.
quests.objective: Cast the 'pwd' spell to reveal your place in the dungeon.
quests.hint: Type 'pwd' and press Enter to see your current chamber.

quests.title: Eyes to See
quests.description: The walls whisper: see what lies around you.
quests.objective: Use 'ls' to reveal nearby rooms and scrolls.
quests.hint: Try 'ls' to survey the room's contents.

quests.title: First Steps
quests.description: A dark passage leads deeper into the dungeon.
quests.objective: Use 'cd cellar' to descend into the cellar.
quests.hint: Use 'cd cellar' to descend into the cellar.

quests.title: Ancient Knowledge
quests.description: A dusty scroll rests on a stone pedestal.
quests.objective: Use 'cat scroll' to read the ancient knowledge.
quests.hint: Try 'cat scroll' to read the ancient knowledge on the pedestal.

quests.title: Shape the World
quests.description: The workshop calls — create something new.
quests.objective: Navigate to the workshop and use 'mkdir' to create a directory.
quests.hint: Use 'mkdir' to shape a new workspace.

quests.title: Spark of Creation
quests.description: Your workspace yearns for a first artifact.
quests.objective: Use 'touch' to create a new file.
quests.hint: Use 'touch notes.txt' to conjure a new file.

quests.title: Seek the Whisper
quests.description: Hidden phrases linger in old scrolls.
quests.objective: Use 'grep' to search for a word within a scroll.
quests.hint: Run 'grep catacombs scroll' to uncover the hidden clue.

quests.title: The Bashcrawl Grimoire
quests.description: Deep in the chapel library, a tome of forgotten spells guards a secret.
quests.objective: Find the hidden study behind the library bookshelf, run the grimoire, and define the 'bc' command.
quests.hint: Find the library, read the tome, then source the grimoire.
quests.reward: 200 XP and the Scriptorium Key (permanent help system access)
quests.prerequisites: amulet and coins in inventory, tome read in library

quests.title: Map the Realm
quests.description: A cartographer's spirit asks for a true picture of where you stand.
quests.objective: Run 'map' to see the world tree.

quests.title: Order the Verses
quests.description: Dust on the verses confuses their order. The scribes ask for a clean list.
quests.objective: From /entrance/scriptorium run a true pipeline: `sort verses | uniq`.

quests.title: Find the Hidden Page
quests.description: Notes flutter behind the shelf. Locate them by name.

quests.title: Wisdom of the Cow
quests.description: A humble cow wanders the field of letters.
quests.hint: Try `cowsay hello` from anywhere, or `./cowherd` in the scriptorium.

quests.title: Gaze the Stars
quests.description: Climb to the observatory and tally the night.
